main.description: Inbound Stripe webhook receiver. Caller (Stripe) MUST sign the request body with the webhook secret stored on `vertex_billing_stripe_customer.stripe_webhook_secret`. PDS verifies the `stripe-signature` header before delegating to the BPMN. Idempotent on `stripe_event_id`.

account.description: Stripe Connect account (acct_*) — used to scope to org_did

duplicate.description: true if this event_id was already ingested (idempotent)
